1.explanation: These two files are the main implementation files for the FormGroup and RadioButtonGroup components. The bug report requests the ability to pass a custom id to the <legend> and set aria-labelledby on the <fieldset> for both components. Reviewing the skeletons, these files currently do not support passing custom props to the <legend> or setting aria-labelledby on the <fieldset>. To fix the bug, these files need to be updated to accept and apply these props accordingly. The other files (index.js, test.js, story.js) are either re-exports, tests, or stories, and do not contain the component logic that needs to be changed to address the bug.
1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario is about improving accessibility for screen readers in the FormGroup and RadioButtonGroup React components. Specifically, there is currently no way to supply a custom id to the <legend> element, nor to set the fieldset's aria-labelledby attribute to reference that legend id. This is needed so that screen readers can properly associate the fieldset with its legend, as shown in the provided image where <legend id="row-height-label"> is referenced by <fieldset aria-labelledby="row-height-label">.
